## Demande de l'utilisateur
ConfigMap de configuration pour redis montée en fichier dans son Deployment (namespace production)

apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: production
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: redis-config
  namespace: production
data:
  redis.conf: |
    bind 0.0.0.0
    port 6379
    maxmemory 512mb
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis-deployment
  namespace: production
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:7.2.5-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 6379
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "256Mi"
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          volumeMounts:
            - name: redis-config-volume
              mountPath: /usr/local/etc/redis/redis.conf
              subPath: redis.conf
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 6379
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 6379
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
      volumes:
        - name: redis-config-volume
          configMap:
            name: redis-config
            items:
              - key: redis.conf
                path: redis.conf
